In this position, you will work in the following shifts:

Monday to Friday in 2 shifts: 06:00 - 15:00 / 15:00 - 00:00. 

A cleanroom is a very clean and sterile working environment: designed to limit or, if possible, exclude contamination from the product process. The contamination may consist in dust or fibers, airborne microorganisms, fine dust or chemical vapors. The production of medicines and microelectronics, but also, for example, the cultivation of bacteria in Petri dishes, require a cleanroom environment to varying degrees.

In this position you work in a production/cleaning environment. Of course, you also test products. In addition, your daily work as a cleanroom process operator consists of:

- Cleaning high-tech parts (technical parts) following instructions and protocols.
- Perform assembly and cleaning work.
- Performing quality measurements.
- Working on the basis of instructions and drawings (Powerpoint).

To succeed in this role, it is preferable that you already have technical knowledge / technical experience in a cleanroom or any other production environment.

In additional, we ask for the following:

- Engagement and enthusiasm.
- You recognize yourself in the following keywords: involved, stress resistant, positive, responsible, team player, visionary, helpful, precise and safety first.
- English language skills, since all safety instructions, work instructions and social conversations are in English.
- You are able to work in a structured and independent manner.
- You are able to read technical drawings and work according to work instructions
- You live in the area of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel or Valkenswaard.

As a Cleanroom Operator, you will work in a modern ISO Grade 2 cleanroom where high-value, mainly metal components are cleaned, inspected, and packaged.
